description:
Scenario: a contributor doing a cookie-cutter propagation reads the metadata-server source for guidance on which crate is the canonical reference, sees:

- helpers.rs:4: 'Items here mirror the canonical extension-server helpers pattern (see jmap_sharing_server::helpers for the template).'
- lib.rs:281: 'Down-cast Metadata -> O via serde round-trip. This is the canonical bridge for the JmapBackend::get_objects generic parameter; identical to sharing-server's mock pattern.'
- PLAN.md:49-52: 'Canonical template: ~/PROJECT/crate-jmap/crate-jmap-sharing-server/ — closest single-extension-server analog. MetadataBackend is cookie-cut from SharingBackend; ...'
- PLAN.md:55-57: 'The canonical extension-server template is jmap-mail-server per the workspace AGENTS.md canonical-template propagation rule; jmap-sharing-server is the closest precedent...'

Workspace AGENTS.md (/home/mark/PROJECT/crate-jmap/AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' section) is explicit: 'Extension server canonical: jmap-mail-server'. Sharing-server is a sibling like metadata, not a canonical template.

Maintenance consequence: when sharing-server diverges from mail-server (it has, on details like the unknown-account create_object guard), metadata follows sharing-server's pattern instead of mail-server's. Over time, sharing and metadata co-drift away from the canonical, and the cookie-cutter intent fragments. The PLAN.md attempt to thread the needle (line 55-57) actually concedes the inversion: it states the canonical is mail-server but then says cookie-cutting is done from sharing.

Fix: update helpers.rs:4 to cite jmap_mail_server::helpers. Update lib.rs:281 to remove the 'sharing-server' reference (or replace with 'mail-server'). Update PLAN.md:49-57 to either (a) remove the sharing-server template framing entirely, or (b) document a per-section deviation (e.g. 'MetadataBackend's single-object-family shape borrowed from sharing-server, but trait shape and propagation rule follow mail-server').
title: helpers.rs and src/lib.rs test_support docs name 'jmap_sharing_server' / 'sharing-server' as the canonical template, contradicting workspace AGENTS.md which names jmap-mail-server
